method:
Record optional enemy prototypes through actual mGBA inputs and ordinary AI.

The lab's own request API selects a case and clears unrelated actors. Navigation,
safe actor positions, player facing, inventory and player healing are disclosed
fixtures. This tool never assigns enemy HP, facing, flags, state, timer, pose or
animation clocks, and never writes room geometry, palettes, VRAM or framebuffers.
Native PNGs are untouched emulator output. Filmstrip labels are outside them.

scenarios.name: gilt-leech-charge-and-wall
scenarios.note: Native30-update tell, fixed-heading1.625px/update charge and wall stop. Initial enemy/player coordinates and the perpendicular player dodge are fixtures on unchanged dry floor. Enemy HP/state/facing/timer are never assigned.

scenarios.name: root-maw-buried-and-sword
scenarios.note: Real B sword inputs before/after natural24-frame emergence, then ordinary exposed/retreat/buried loop. Player positioning/healing only; no enemyHP/state/clock writes.

scenarios.name: reliquary-snout-front-and-rear
scenarios.note: Real B sword on front armor, then rear during its natural60-update locked tell. Actor/player position fixtures do not change facing, HP, timers, flags or AI state. Clang is diagnosed by the game event plus unchangedHP.

scenarios.name: reliquary-snout-arrow-defense
scenarios.note: Actual A bow shots from front/rear during the natural locked tell. Shot origins account for ordinary authored hand and collision offsets. No enemyHP/state/facing/timer writes.

scenarios.name: root-maw-bomb-buried
scenarios.note: Damage-interface counterprobe: actual A bomb input and its full150-update fuse; target coordinates alone are placed into the blast on update149. Natural buried/exposed phase and HP are never assigned. This fixture verifies phase damage rules, not unassisted combat positioning.

scenarios.name: root-maw-bomb-exposed
scenarios.note: Damage-interface counterprobe: actual A bomb input and its full150-update fuse; target coordinates alone are placed into the blast on update149. Natural buried/exposed phase and HP are never assigned. This fixture verifies phase damage rules, not unassisted combat positioning.

scenarios.name: gilt-leech-contact-iframes
scenarios.note: Repeated coordinate-only player overlap fixture, no healing during22updates, verifies contact damage and ordinary invulnerability. Neither actor HP nor AI clock is assigned.

scenarios.note: Live optional prototype AI on unchanged real room terrain. Player HP replenishment is a survival fixture; no enemy behavior/HP writes.
